description: This file contains Makefile definitions and shell scripts for configuring, installing, and managing OpenSSL modules, engines, and providers within a build system, including embedding licensing information.

methods.name: Package/openssl/add-module
methods.description: Defines a complex set of build steps for adding an OpenSSL module with specified parameters such as type, name, directory, and package name, including installation and post-installation scripts.

methods.name: Package/openssl/add-engine
methods.description: A wrapper that adds an engine module by invoking add-module with 'engine' as the type.

methods.name: Package/openssl/add-provider
methods.description: A wrapper that adds a provider module by invoking add-module with 'provider' as the type.
